ayahs.3: Nazdeek ki zameen par aur woh maghloob hone ke baad anqareeb ghaalib aa jaayenge.
ayahs.4: Chand saal mein hi. Is se pehle aur is ke baad bhi ikhtiyaar Allah Taala hi ka hai. Is roz musalman shaadmaan honge.
ayahs.5: Allah ki madad se, woh jis ki chaahta hai madad karta hai. Asal ghaalib aur mehrbaan wahi hai.
ayahs.6: Allah ka waada hai, Allah Taala apne waade ka khilaaf nahin karta lekin aksar log nahin jaante.
ayahs.7: Woh to (sirf) dunyawi zindagi ke zaahir ko (hi) jaante hain aur aakhirat se to bilkul hi be-khabar hain.
ayahs.8: Kya in logon ne apne dil mein yeh ghaur nahin kiya? Ke Allah Taala ne aasmanon ko aur zameen aur un ke darmiyaan jo kuchh hai sab ko behtareen qareene se muqarrar waqt tak ke liye (hi) paida kiya hai, haan aksar log yaqeenan apne Rabb ki mulaaqaat ke munkir hain.
ayahs.9: Kya unhon ne zameen par chal phir kar yeh nahin dekha ke un se pehle logon ka anjaam kaisa (bura) hua? Woh un se bahut zyada tawana (aur taaqatwar) the aur unhon ne (bhi) zameen boi joti thi aur un se zyada aabaad ki thi aur un ke paas un ke Rasool roshan dalail le kar aaye the. Yeh to naamumkin tha ke Allah Taala un par zulm karta lekin (dar-asal) woh khud apni jaanon par zulm karte the.
ayahs.10: Phir aakhir bura karne walon ka bahut hi bura anjaam hua, is liye ke woh Allah Taala ki aayaton ko jhutlaate aur un ki hansi udaate the.
ayahs.11: Allah Taala hi makhlooq ki ibtida karta hai phir wahi use dobaara paida karega phir tum sab isi ki taraf lautaaye jaaoge.
ayahs.12: Aur jis din qayamat qaem hogi to gunahgaar hairat-zada reh jaayenge.
ayahs.13: Aur un ke tamaam-tar shareekon mein se ek bhi un ka sifarishi na hoga aur (khud yeh bhi) apne shareekon ke munkir ho jaayenge.
ayahs.14: Aur jis din qayamat qaem hogi is din (jamaaten) alag alag ho jaayengi.
ayahs.15: Jo imaan la kar nek aamaal karte rahe woh to jannat mein khush-o-khurram kar diye jaayenge.
ayahs.16: Aur jinhon ne kufr kiya tha aur hamari aayaton ko aur aakhirat ki mulaaqaat ko jhoota thahraaya tha woh sab azaab mein pakad kar haazir rakhe jaayenge.
ayahs.17: Pas Allah Taala ki tasbeeh padha karo jabke tum shaam karo aur jab subah karo.
ayahs.18: Tamaam taareefon ke laaiq aasman-o-zameen mein sirf wahi hai teesre pahar ko aur zuhr ke waqt bhi (us ki paakizgi bayan karo).
ayahs.19: (Wahi) zinda ko murda se aur murda ko zinda se nikaalta hai. Aur wahi zameen ko us ki maut ke baad zinda karta hai isi tarah tum (bhi) nikaale jaaoge.
ayahs.20: Allah ki nishaaniyon mein se hai ke us ne tum ko mitti se paida kiya phir ab insan ban kar (chalte phirte) phail rahe ho.
ayahs.21: Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se hai ke tumhari hi jins se biwiyan paida keen taake tum un se aaraam paao us ne tumhare darmiyaan muhabbat aur hamdardi qaem kar di, yaqeenan ghaur-o-fikr karne walon ke liye is mein bahut si nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.22: Is (ki qudrat) ki nishaaniyon mein se aasmanon aur zameen ki paidaish aur tumhari zabaanon aur rangaton ka ikhtilaaf (bhi) hai, daanishmandon ke liye is mein yaqeenan badi nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.23: Aur (bhi) us ki (qudrat ki) nishani tumhari raaton aur din ki neend mein hai aur us ke fazl (yaani rozi) ko tumhara talaash karna bhi hai. Jo log (kaan laga kar) sunne ke aadi hain un ke liye is mein bahut si nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.24: Aur us ki nishaaniyon mein se ek yeh (bhi) hai ke woh tumhein daraane aur umeedwar banaane ke liye bijliyan dikhaata hai aur aasman se baarish barsaata hai aur is murda zameen ko zinda kar deta hai, is mein (bhi) aqalmandon ke liye bahut si nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.25: Us ki ek nishani yeh bhi hai ke aasman-o-zameen isi ke hukm se qaem hain, phir jab woh tumhein awaaz dega sirf ek baar ki awaaz ke saath hi tum sab zameen se nikal aaoge.
ayahs.26: Aur zameen-o-aasman ki har cheez us ki milkiyat hai aur har ek us ke farmaan ke maatihat hai.
ayahs.27: Wahi hai jo awwal baar makhlooq ko paida karta hai phir se dobaara paida karega aur yeh to us par bahut hi aasaan hai. Isi ki behtareen aur aala sifat hai, aasmanon mein aur zameen mein bhi aur wahi ghalbe wala hikmat wala hai.
ayahs.28: Allah Taala ne tumhare liye ek misaal khud tumhari hi bayan farmaai, jo kuchh hum ne tumhein de rakha hai kya is mein tumhare ghulamon mein se bhi koi tumhara shareek hai? Ke tum aur woh is mein baraabar darje ke ho? Aur tum un ka aisa khatra rakhte ho jaisa khud apnon ka, hum aql rakhne walon ke liye isi tarah khol khol kar aayaten bayan kar dete hain.
ayahs.29: Balke baat yeh hai ke yeh zaalim to baghair ilm ke khwahish-parasti kar rahe hain, ise kaun raah dikhaaye jise Allah Taala raah se hata de, un ka ek bhi madadgaar nahin.
ayahs.30: Pas aap yak-so ho kar apna munh deen ki taraf mutawajjah kar dein. Allah Taala ki woh fitrat jis par us ne logon ko paida kiya hai, Allah Taala ke banaaye ko badalna nahin, yehi seedha deen hai lekin aksar log nahin samajhte.
ayahs.31: (Logo!) Allah Taala ki taraf ruju ho kar us se darte raho aur namaz ko qaem rakho aur mushrikeen mein se na ho jaao.
ayahs.32: Un logon mein se jinhon ne apne deen ko tukde tukde kar diya aur khud bhi giroh giroh ho gaye har giroh is cheez par jo us ke paas hai magan hai.
ayahs.33: Logon ko jab kabhi koi museebat pahunchti hai to apne Rabb ki taraf (poori tarah) ruju ho kar duayen karte hain, phir jab woh apni taraf se rehmat ka zaaiqa chakhata hai to un mein se ek jamaat apne Rabb ke saath shirk karne lagti hai.
ayahs.34: Taake woh is cheez ki na-shukri karen jo hum ne unhein di hai achchha tum faaida utha lo! Abhi abhi tumhein maloom ho jaayega.
ayahs.35: Kya hum ne un par koi daleel naazil ki hai jo ise bayan karti hai jise yeh Allah ke saath shareek kar rahe hain.
ayahs.36: Aur jab hum logon ko rehmat ka maza chakhate hain to woh khoob khush ho jaate hain aur agar unhein un ke haathon ke kartoot ki wajah se koi buraai pahunche to ek dam woh mehaz na-umeed ho jaate hain.
ayahs.37: Kya unhon ne nahin dekha ke Allah Taala jise chaahe kushada rozi deta hai aur jise chaahe tang, is mein bhi un logon ke liye jo imaan laate hain nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.38: Pas qaraabat-daar ko, miskeen ko, musafir ko har ek ko us ka haq dijiye, yeh un ke liye behtar hai jo Allah Taala ka munh dekhna chaahte hon, aise hi log najaat paane wale hain.
ayahs.39: Tum jo sood par dete ho ke logon ke maal mein badhta rahe woh Allah Taala ke haan nahin badhta. Aur jo kuchh sadqa zakaat tum Allah Taala ka munh dekhne (aur khushnudi ke liye) do to aise log hi apna do-chand karne wale hain.
ayahs.40: Allah Taala woh hai jis ne tumhein paida kiya phir rozi di phir maar daalega phir zinda kar dega bataao tumhare shareekon mein se koi bhi aisa hai jo in mein se kuchh bhi kar sakta ho. Allah Taala ke liye paaki aur bartarri hai har us shareek se jo yeh log muqarrar karte hain.
ayahs.41: Khushki aur tari mein logon ki bad-aamaliyon ke baais fasaad phail gaya. Is liye ke unhein un ke baaz kartooton ka phal Allah Taala chakha de (bahut) mumkin hai ke woh baaz aa jaayen.
ayahs.42: Zameen mein chal phir kar dekho to sahi ke aglon ka anjaam kya hua. Jin mein aksar log mushrik the.
ayahs.43: Pas aap apna rukh is sachche aur seedhe deen ki taraf hi rakhen qabl is ke ke woh din aa jaaye jis ka tal jaana Allah Taala ki taraf se hai hi nahin, is din sab mutafarriq ho jaayenge.
ayahs.44: Kufr karne walon par un ke kufr ka wabaal hoga aur nek kaam karne wale apni hi aaraamgah sanwaar rahe hain.
ayahs.45: Taake Allah Taala unhein apne fazl se jaza de jo imaan laaye aur nek aamaal kiye woh kaafiron ko dost nahin rakhta hai.
ayahs.46: Us ki nishaaniyon mein se khushkhabriyan dene wali hawaon ko chalaana bhi hai is liye ke tumhein apni rehmat se lutf-andoz kare, aur is liye ke us ke hukm se kashtiyan chalen, aur is liye ke us ke fazl ko tum dhoondo, aur is liye ke tum shukr-guzari karo.
ayahs.47: Aur hum ne aap se pehle bhi apne Rasoolon ko un ki qaum ki taraf bheja woh un ke paas daleelen laaye. Phir hum ne gunahgaaron se intiqaam liya. Hum par mominon ki madad karna laazim hai.
ayahs.48: Allah Taala hawaayen chalaata hai woh abr ko uthaati hain phir Allah Taala apni mansha ke mutabiq ise aasman mein phaila deta hai aur is ke tukde tukde kar deta hai phir aap dekhte hain ke us ke andar se qatre nikalte hain, aur jinhein Allah chaahta hai un bandon par paani barsaata hai to woh khush khush ho jaate hain.
ayahs.49: Yaqeen maanna ke baarish un par barsne se pehle pehle to woh na-umeed ho rahe the.
ayahs.50: Pas aap rehmat-e-Ilahi ke aasar dekhen ke zameen ki maut ke baad kis tarah Allah Taala ise zinda kar deta hai? Kuchh shak nahin ke wahi murdon ko zinda karne wala hai, aur woh har har cheez par qaadir hai.
ayahs.51: Aur agar hum baad-e-tund chala dein aur yeh log inhi kheton ko (murjhaai hui) zard padi hui dekh len to phir is ke baad na-shukri karne lagen.
ayahs.52: Beshak aap murdon ko nahin suna sakte aur na behron ko (apni) awaaz suna sakte hain jabke woh peeth pher kar mud gaye hon.
ayahs.53: Aur na aap andhon ko un ki gumraahi se hidayat karne wale hain aap to sirf un hi logon ko sunaate hain jo hamari aayaton par imaan rakhte hain pas wahi ita'at karne wale hain.
ayahs.54: Allah Taala woh hai jis ne tumhein kamzori ki haalat mein paida kiya phir is kamzori ke baad tawanaai di, phir is tawanaai ke baad kamzori aur budhaapa diya jo chaahta hai paida karta hai, woh sab se poora waaqif aur sab par poora qaadir hai.
ayahs.55: Aur jis din qayamat barpa ho jaayegi gunahgaar log qasmen khaayenge ke (dunya mein) ek ghadi ke siwa nahin thahre, isi tarah yeh behke hue hi rahe.
ayahs.56: Aur jin logon ko ilm aur imaan diya gaya woh jawab denge ke tum to jaisa ke Kitaabullah mein hai yaum-e-qayamat tak thahre rahe. Aaj ka yeh din qayamat hi ka din hai lekin tum to yaqeen hi nahin maante the.
ayahs.57: Pas is din zaalimon ko un ka uzr bahana kuchh kaam na aayega aur na un se tauba aur amal talab kiya jaayega.
ayahs.58: Beshak hum ne is Quran mein logon ke saamne kul misaalen bayan kar di hain. Aap un ke paas koi bhi nishani laayen, yeh kaafir to yehi kahenge ke tum (behooda-go) bilkul jhoote ho.
ayahs.59: Allah Taala in logon ke dilon par jo samajh nahin rakhte yun hi mohr kar deta hai.
ayahs.60: Pas aap sabr karen yaqeenan Allah ka waada sachcha hai. Aap ko woh log halka (be-sabra) na karen jo yaqeen nahin rakhte.
